contract: Completed operations must form an exact prefix of the ordered execution plan.
Only the next ordered operation may be observed.
A failed apply observation or failed immediate verification halts forward progress.
Failure routes to rollback_required but does not perform rollback.
No later operation may be authorized after a halt decision.
The checkpoint contains no transport, credential, command, apply, rollback or production-writer capability.
pass_requires: out-of-order and duplicate completion fail closed
success advances only one ordered step
